questions.q: For the system x/(2x+1) >= 1/4 and 6x/(4x-1) < 1/2, what is the common solution set?
questions.explanation: The first inequality gives x in (-infinity,-1/2) union [1/2,infinity). The second gives x in (-1/8,1/4). These sets do not overlap, so the system has no common solution.

questions.q: Consider x + 2y <= 3, 3x + 4y >= 12, x >= 0 and y >= 1. Which statement is correct?
options: A) The feasible region is a bounded triangle
B) The feasible region is unbounded
C) The system has no solution
D) Every point in the first quadrant is feasible
questions.answer: C) The system has no solution
questions.explanation: From y>=1 and x>=0, the first inequality forces x+2y<=3, so only a narrow region near the y-axis is possible. But in that region 3x+4y cannot reach 12 while the first inequality remains satisfied. Therefore the half-planes have no common feasible point.

questions.q: What best describes the solution set of 2x+y >= 8, x+2y >= 10, x>=0, y>=0?
questions.explanation: Each inequality selects a half-plane in the first quadrant on or above its boundary line. Their common region continues indefinitely toward larger positive x and y. Hence the feasible region is unbounded.
